scientific_integrity: Finite exact-rational diagnostics corroborate an all-depth analytic proof. Equivalent unindexed historical work remains a bibliographic risk; no independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real sign multipliers on full finite positive-mass binary trees, not suppression transforms, incomplete filtrations, nonbinary branching, general Lp, or complex phases. title: Sharp nodewise-bias stability of finite binary Haar endpoint unconditionality
